nodes.label: ADR-001 MAVROS instead of uXRCE-DDS
nodes.rationale: Mixing bridges breaks the twin; MAVROS is serial-friendly on Pixracer and uxrce_dds_client on fmu-v4 flash is uncertain.

nodes.label: ADR-003 One PX4 version for SITL and Pixracer
nodes.norm_label: adr-003 one px4 version for sitl and pixracer
nodes.rationale: Same firmware on SITL and Pixracer so params/EKF2 behave identically (risk R2).

nodes.label: ADR-004 CycloneDDS + zenoh bridge for fleet network
nodes.norm_label: adr-004 cyclonedds + zenoh bridge for fleet network
nodes.rationale: Cyclone is reliable across host-networked containers; multicast over WiFi is not, so zenoh-bridge-ros2dds bridges WiFi.

nodes.label: Settings Layering (bisg.conf / docker/.env / scenario YAML)
nodes.rationale: One key lives in exactly one place: project defaults in config/bisg.conf, machine-only values in docker/.env, world/vehicle content in scenario YAML; new knobs also get conf_default in scripts/_common.sh, never hard-coded.

nodes.label: Sim-to-real parity rules
nodes.rationale: Drone nodes must not import isaacsim/pegasus/omni nor subscribe to ground truth (except vio_mock and tests), so sim and real stay interchangeable.

nodes.label: MAVROS odometry/out unprefixed frame split
nodes.rationale: MAVROS odom plugin only recognises literal odom/base_link frame ids; contract-prefixed names silently broke horizontal fusion, so vio_mock publishes two differently-framed messages.

nodes.norm_label: fresh start rule (no code from ~/isaacsim or ~/swarm_ws)
nodes.rationale: Earlier attempts drifted and were not reproducible; ideas may be re-implemented but files are never copied.

nodes.label: NVIDIA Driver 580 Branch Requirement
nodes.rationale: The 595.x/R590 branch segfaults Isaac Sim 5.1's RTX renderer; check_env.sh hard-fails on any 59x driver.

nodes.label: Local-branch submodule edit workflow
nodes.rationale: No upstream push access and no fork wanted: edits live on a 'local' branch at the pinned tag, rebased onto new tags; builds use whatever is checked out, so no patch files.

nodes.label: Never git submodule update --remote
nodes.rationale: It silently moves the pin without the fetch/rebase/commit sequence and ADR update.
